_meta.title: CPI headline: index numbers and year-on-year rates
_meta.file: sources/releases/CPIHistory (1).pdf (supplied by the maintainer; not committed)
_meta.tables: Table B1, CPI headline index numbers (Dec 2024 = 100), page 1; Table B2, CPI headline year-on-year rates, pages 2 and 3
_meta.publisher_basis: The file does not name its publisher on the page. It is attributed to Stats SA because its footnotes say the rates are the official rates as published in the monthly CPI release and point to the Stats SA website, and because its 2022 to 2026 rows match Table B of Stats SA P0141 September 2026 (page 4) exactly.
_meta.data_released_basis: The file has no release date. Its latest values are for September 2026, which Stats SA released on 21 October 2026 (P0141 September 2026, cover page).
joins: Table B1 footnote 1: primary urban areas up to and including December 2008, all urban areas from January 2009; the series were linked to give a continuous index.
Table B1 footnote 2: substantial changes were made to the compilation of the CPI in January 2009.
Table B2 has annual averages only for 1911 to 1921; monthly rates start in January 1922.
Table B1 (the index) starts in January 1980, so rand comparisons can only start in 1980.
The file does not say what areas or methods the rates before 1980 cover.
_meta.rounding: Table B2 footnote 3: the rates are the official published rates; rates worked out from the rounded Table B1 index can differ. In 2009 the difference reaches 1.8 percentage points (August 2009: 6.4% published, 4.6% from the index).
_meta.parsed_with: Values extracted from the PDF text and checked: every row has 12 months and an average (9 months for 2026); 2022 to 2026 match P0141 September 2026 Table B.
